findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "creators" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_game, get_listing_link · Public sink: get_launch_checklist, get_listing_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_game, get_listing_link · Public sink: get_launch_checklist, get_listing_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_game" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
